import numpy as np
a=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png')).astype(int)
H,W,_=a.shape
r,g,b=a[...,0],a[...,1],a[...,2]
# classes
yellow=(r>80)&(g>60)&(b<60)
gray=(abs(r-g)<12)&(abs(g-b)<12)&(r>40)
bright=(r+g+b)>300
# downsample to ascii 64x36
gh,gw=36,86
for yy in range(gh):
    line=''
    for xx in range(gw):
        y0,y1=yy*H//gh,(yy+1)*H//gh
        x0,x1=xx*W//gw,(xx+1)*W//gw
        blk_y=yellow[y0:y1,x0:x1].mean()
        blk_g=gray[y0:y1,x0:x1].mean()
        blk_b=bright[y0:y1,x0:x1].mean()
        if blk_y>0.15: c='Y'
        elif blk_b>0.3: c='*'
        elif blk_g>0.4: c='.'
        else:
            m=a[y0:y1,x0:x1].reshape(-1,3).mean(0)
            c='#' if m.mean()>25 else ('+' if m.mean()>10 else ' ')
        line+=c
    print(line)
\""
